ios.desc:
Transform your home with the power of AI, and refine it to perfection. Deco AI is your personal interior designer, generating stunning design ideas from any photo in seconds, then letting you tweak them until they're just right.

Snap a picture, choose from diverse styles (modern, minimalist, boho, and more!), and watch your space evolve. Get personalized recommendations for furniture, decor, and color palettes that perfectly match your chosen aesthetic. Iterate on the AI's suggestions, refining the design until it feels truly human and uniquely yours.

Deco AI is perfect for:

Homeowners: Visualize your dream home and fine-tune it to your exact preferences.

Renters: Experiment with design without commitment.

Real Estate Professionals: Stage properties virtually to impress clients.

Features:

Instant Makeovers: AI-powered design transformations in seconds.

40+ Design Styles: Explore a wide range of aesthetics.

Smart Recommendations: Furniture, decor, and color suggestions.

Iterative Refinement: Tweak and perfect the AI's designs.

Save & Share: Keep your favorite designs and collaborate with others.

Download Deco AI and unlock the potential of your space today!

Deco AI is offering weekly, monthly, and yearly subscription plans that are necessary to unlock unlimited designs with an in-app purchase.
